Traumasoft puts no cost center on a vehicle, and none on a shift profile
either -- Lists/Schedule/ShiftProfiles returns id and name and nothing
else. Without this file every report infers a truck's station from the
shift profile it ran legs under, then the crew who staffed that profile,
then their employee cost_center_name. That answers where the truck
WORKED. It is read as where the truck BELONGS, and the two come apart
exactly when it matters: a unit covering a neighbouring station for a
week, or a truck that ran nothing at all.
THE TAGS ARE CURRENT, NOT HISTORICAL. Using this for a past month assumes
no vehicle changed station since it was built. The generated file records
its build date so that can be judged.
A vehicle the generator could not resolve is absent rather than guessed,
and callers fall back to inferring as before. Add those by hand -- either
